text_block_list.name: Opera O & Doto
text_block_list.text: Hyaaah!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Together, we can make the play even
more
exciting! Isn't that right, Doto?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...!
Yes, ma'am!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to get even stronger! I'll
redeem myself
at the spring Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Haha... So much for the data. So much
for
everything I "knew"...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: (I can't believe it. Their stats were improving during the race.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Their strength can't be measured in
numbers.
Those two shattered the
thresholds I
painstakingly calculated as
if they were nothin'.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(I got ahead of myself. I changed the

seven-centimeter gap... and started
thinking I'd
changed fate itself.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: But this race... This had to be destiny.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Chatter, chatter...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Wow, talk about a letdown...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
The classic-year racers are so
underwhelming. I
thought Shakur was at
least okay-ish, but that run
just now says
otherwise.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... The Triple Crown races this year
felt like
there was zero competition.
Pretty lame,
compared to how hard
Opera O and Doto push
each other.

Shakur got a lucky break this year, but I
can't
imagine her standing a chance
against the runners
coming next year.
Guess this is the end of her,
huh?

The representative of the "weakest
generation"
may stand above the rest in
her year, but she's
still weak.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When Air Shakur returns from the race,
something
is clearly wrong.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list: 着替えたらすぐに帰ろう
choice_data_list_en: Let's head home as soon as you change.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there was something else I wanted
to say
about today's race...

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Doto really tried her best, didn't she? It
made me
want to cheer her on even
more!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I'm okay. You take it.
choice_data_list: タクシー、もうすぐ来るから――
choice_data_list_en: The taxi will be here soon, so—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list: 学園の中のほうがまだ静かだから
choice_data_list_en: Because it's still quieter inside the academy.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Fine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur stays silent for the entire taxi
ride.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Wait.
choice_data_list_en: I'll contact you first thing tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
My next goal race hasn't changed. I still
want to
run the spring Tenno Sho, just
like we planned.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The spring Tenno Sho is the longest G1,
clocking
in at 3,200 meters. With her
aptitude for long
distances, Air Shakur
should be able to do well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The only problem is...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Opera O and Doto are definitely gonna
be
there... Narita Top Road too.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
We'll need to come up with a strategy to
beat
them. I'll start on a new dataset...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Then... we just gotta train till my
numbers are
better than theirs...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Sure.
choice_data_list: その話も、明日にしようか
choice_data_list_en: Let's save that conversation for tomorrow too.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list: 来年は君の時代にしよう
来年は貴方の時代にしよう
choice_data_list_en: Let's make next year your era.
Let's make next year your era.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I keep watch over Air Shakur as she
leaves. That's
not the only thing I can do
for her, though. In
fact, I know exactly
what to do.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Haaah...
choice_data_list: （見てきたものを伝えるだけだ）
（見てきたものを伝えるだけ）
choice_data_list_en: (All I have to do is tell them what I saw.)
(All I need to do is tell them what I saw.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Calm down. I've collected the data. All
that's left
is to calculate the thresholds I
need to reach in
order to win.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(I've got no choice but to meet those
numbers, no
matter how ridiculous they
are.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(What the... I'm going to lose? And not
just
that...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
These are the same values I got before I
changed
the seven-centimeter gap. This
is my worst
possible fate...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: So essentially... nothing's really changed.

The representative of the "weakest
generation"
may stand above the rest in
her year, but she's
still weak.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I see how it is.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: So even you want to see my downfall, Parcae.
